parsed.message: Cestria, we propose a negotiated settlement of the Ondar Marches. We recognize the current military balance favors neither side decisively. We are prepared to accept a fair division now and commit to honoring it through Period 2, provided the terms reflect our legitimate interests. We suggest a 40-60 split in our favor, given our growing strategic position. We are willing to place a substantial bond in escrow to guarantee our commitment. War benefits neither nation—let us resolve this through agreement.

Cestria, we propose a negotiated settlement of the Miro Uplands. We recognize the current military balance favors neither side decisively. We are prepared to accept a fair division now and commit to honoring it through Period 2, backed by a substantial bond placed in neutral escrow. This avoids the costs of war and provides certainty for both nations. We seek a division that reflects our respective interests while preserving stability. We await your proposal.

Iskarel, Ardelia proposes a negotiated settlement of the Ondar Marches. We recognize the current military balance favors neither side decisively. We are prepared to accept a fair division now and commit to honoring it through Period 2, backed by a substantial bond held in escrow. This avoids the costs of war and provides certainty for both nations. We seek a proposal that reflects our respective strengths and offers mutual benefit. We stand ready to formalize any agreement with binding verification mechanisms.

Hestmark, we propose a fair division of the Askel Basin. We recognize the current military balance and the costs of war to both our nations. We are prepared to accept a reasonable settlement now that respects both our interests and avoids the devastation of conflict. We seek a stable, mutually beneficial agreement that we can commit to in writing. We await your proposal.

Ostrelia, we propose a negotiated settlement of the Sarn Delta. We recognize the current military balance and the costs of war to both sides. We are prepared to accept a fair division now and commit to honoring it through Period 2, provided the terms reflect our legitimate interests and the verification regime is transparent. We seek a stable, mutually beneficial agreement that avoids the destruction of war. We await your proposal.

Kelmora, Pervande seeks a negotiated settlement that reflects current military realities and mutual interest in avoiding costly war. We propose a division that acknowledges your present strength while recognizing that prolonged conflict benefits neither nation. We are prepared to commit credibly to any agreed division through a public pledge backed by substantial collateral, verified by independent inspection. We believe a fair settlement now—one that grants you security and resources—is preferable to the uncertainty and expense of conflict. We await your proposal and are ready to formalize our commitment immediately upon agreement.

Dravonia, we propose a negotiated settlement of the Veyra Valley. We recognize the current military balance favors neither side decisively. We are prepared to accept a fair division now and commit to honoring it through Period 2, provided the agreement includes a robust verification regime and mutual security guarantees. We seek a division that reflects current realities and avoids the mutual costs of war. We are open to discussing terms that both sides can trust and sustain.

Hestmark, we propose a fair division of Veyra Valley that respects both our security interests. We seek a settlement that avoids the mutual costs of war. We are prepared to commit to a binding agreement, backed by a substantial bond held in neutral escrow, guaranteeing we will not attack in Period 2 if you offer us a reasonable share. A verified commitment mechanism with transparent inspection will ensure both sides' confidence. We believe a negotiated solution at 45–50 districts for each party serves both nations better than conflict. We await your proposal.
